{{Quote|When the other slaves broke free, I laughed. Like you, I knew their "escape" was a delusion--for only Sith possess true freedom!|[[Traga un-Vhol]]|<ref name="TOR:TSK" />}}
The '''Unchained''', or '''"Slave Cult"''', was a group of [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] among [[Dromund Kaas rebels|those]] who [[Dromund Kaas rebellion|rebelled]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] at the [[unfinished colossus]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Led by [[Traga un-Vhol]], the slaves believed they could become [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] by following a twisted version of Sith philosophy. They killed other slaves, believing that their rebellion was foolish.<ref name="TOR:TSK" />
